title: Pet-Friendly 6BR Rosemary Beach Home with Beach Access
meta_description: Relax at Brighton Cottage, a pet-friendly 6BR, 3.5BA Rosemary Beach, FL home with private beach access, a screened-in balcony, and pool access. Sleeps 14.

normalized_matching_profile.name: Brighton Cottage
normalized_matching_profile.description: DescriptionHOME HIGHLIGHTS* 1 min walk to Coquina Pool* 1 min walk to beach access* 4 Complimentary Beach Cruiser Bikes* Foosball Table* Complete Clean Bedding Program* Roku TV Streaming on TVs* Two screened-in, covered porches• Pet-Friendly Property (Pets must be approved and there is a $200 pet fee)Tucked into an idyllic neighborhood in Rosemary Beach, Brighton Cottage is a premier 30A rental home with a chic and contemporary vibe. Located 125 yards from the beach and the Gulf of Mexico and closer to the award-winning Coquina Pool. Everything you could want for an unforgettable vacay — the beach, the pool, boutique shopping, restaurants, and a sunny playground— are all within a 5-minute walk of Brighton Cottage.Although you’ll be close to it all at Brighton Cottage, you’ll feel like you’re in your own little world when you arrive. Designed to maximize privacy and provide complete comfort, Brighton Cottage features an elegant open layout, tons of natural light, and a stunning modern design. The living room has airy high ceilings, lots of large windows, and a comfortable sectional sofa and armchairs. In the kitchen, dramatic slabs of granite, stainless steel appliances, a wine cooler, and an impressive French Oak dining table create a pristine, luxurious workspace to prepare some banana pancakes for breakfast or a casual beach day lunch for your group.On the first floor, the first of two master suites has a king-size bed, a private outdoor sitting area, and an ensuite bathroom with a step-in shower. Up the spiral staircase, the second master suite features a king-size bed, an attached bathroom with a walk-in shower, and a private deck space. A third bedroom has a king bed, while two more bedrooms are bunk rooms with twin-over-twin bunks. Another spiral staircase leads up to a third-floor loft area with two cozy twin-size beds tucked under the eaves, views of the Gulf, a seating area with HDTV, and a fun foosball table. A bonus family room has a sleeper sofa and a sun-drenched, screened-in balcony.Brighton Cottage is brimming with luxe details, including pecan hardwoods, custom Roman shades, bespoke maple woodwork and furnishings, and spa-like oversized showers with rain shower heads. Outside on the first floor, there are plenty of comfy lounge spaces to relax with your morning coffee or happy hour cocktail. There’s also a barbecue area for grilling a fresh catch for dinner, and an outdoor shower for rinsing off after a day at the beach. Simply put, Brighton Cottage has it all. And if you need a little more room, the charming Brighton Carriage House is next door.FIRST FLOOR* Screened-in porch* Living room with a large sofa with a built-in chaise lounge, side chairs, coffee table, lamps, HDTV, recessed lighting, and ceiling fan* Kitchen with granite counters, stainless steel appliances, center island with seating for 2* Butler’s pantry with washer/dryer, beverage cooler, and dishwasher* Dining area with seating for 8* Screened-in patio with seating* Outdoor dining with seating for 6* MASTER BEDROOM with king-size bed, dual nightstands, lamps, and access to a private outdoor courtyard* EN-SUITE BATHROOM with walk-in shower, double vanitySECOND FLOOR* A bonus family room and sitting area, with sleeper sofa.* Covered screened-in porch with an outdoor sofa and two side chairs* 2nd MASTER BEDROOM with king-size bed, dual nightstands, lamps, ceiling fan, and en suite bathroom with a single vanity and walk-in shower. This bedroom also has a private porch off the bedroom and another porch off the bedroom that connects to the bunk room.* BEDROOM with a custom twin-over-twin bunk bed * BEDROOM with a king-size bed, corner chair, HDTV, and ceiling fan.* BATHROOM with a single vanity and a tub/shower. This Jack-n-Jill bathroom is shared with the bedroom above and the bunk room below.* BEDROOM with a built-in, twin-over-twin bunk bedTHIRD FLOOR* BEDROOM open to the great room below with 2 twin-size beds and a seating area with HDTV, and Foosball table.
